numberToWords.moneyDecimalsHint: Money: at most 2 decimal places (no silent truncation)
numberToWords.numericDecimalsHint: Numeric: at most 6 decimal places (exact representation required)
numberToWords.helpNumeric: Numeric format: Converts number to words (e.g., 123 → one hundred twenty-three)
numberToWords.helpMoney: Money format: Converts amount to words with currency (e.g., 123 → one hundred twenty-three dollars)
numberToWords.helpMoneyRuHistorical: Russian money uses historical /N-KK ruble URLs (e.g., 1.50 → /1-50).
numberToWords.helpMoneyEnLegacy: English money uses the USD legacy route (e.g., 1.50 → /1.50-money-usd).

percentage.helpOf: Example: If number = 100 and percentage = 20, then 20% of 100 = 20
percentage.helpAdd: Example: If number = 100 and percentage = 20, then 100 + 20% = 120
percentage.helpSubtract: Example: If number = 100 and percentage = 20, then 100 - 20% = 80
